conventions.owner: This file owns Part II structure, battles, recruits, guests and mechanics. Item drops are owned by weapons-and-items.json `where` rows (chapter "Part II Ch N"); the .md view lists them from there. Units are owned by site/src/data/characters.
conventions.unconfirmed: A value ending in '?' is unconfirmed. Source conflicts live in open_questions, not in rows.
conventions.hero: [Hero] is the Flame Lord whose War Path you play (Cai, Dietrich, Theodora or Leda). Theodora and Bertrand fight on every War Path.

overview.unlock: Finish any Part I Path. The Strife Obelisk appears in the Obelisk Chamber.
overview.per_lord: Each Flame Lord runs their own War Path. A lord's Part I army reaches Part III only if that lord's War Path is done (or skipped).
overview.skip: After one full War Path, later ones can be Skipped: units go to Part III with some EXP, less EXP and Skill EXP than playing. Game8 advises playing all four for unit growth.
overview.same_map_set: The six chapters are the same for every lord; only dialogue and lord facilities change.
overview.no_free_time: No Free Time, World Map, shops, subquests or recruiting outside battles. Turns don't pass in Preparations; you can't leave base.
overview.defeat: Every battle: [Hero], Theodora or Bertrand falls.
overview.deploy: 10 units in Ch 1, 13 from Ch 2 (Game8 boxes). If you deploy fewer than the cap, the game fills slots with temporary guests.
overview.enemy_baseline: Ch 1: 44 enemies at start, most Lv 35, all Advanced classes with Silver weapons, 8 with an HP reserve. New enemy classes: Dragoon (Bau rider), Dreadnought, Caladrius (Ornius rider, black magic), Cataphract.
overview.ideal_tier: Advanced classes with Da Mina weapons (Game8, every chapter).

carryover.into_part2: Only items equipped on each unit come into Part II. Consumables can't be placed in a unit's inventory at the transfer screen. Unequipped Part I items wait in storage and return in Part III.
carryover.handouts: Every chapter gives each unit 1 Concoction and 1 Antitoxin (full inventory sends them to storage) plus class weapons, usually +2 or +3. The handout weapons do not carry into Part III.
carryover.out_of_part2: Units keep levels, classes and ranks into Part III. Drops (Vendetta, Angela, Dagda's Club, the +1 weapons) are re-sold by the Drifting Reliquary after a Part II clear (see weapons-and-items.json).

prep.licenses: Each chapter refills to 5 Beginner, 5 Specialty and 5 Advanced Licenses. Unused ones don't stack: spend them every chapter.
prep.divine_sand: Refills every chapter. Use Blessings in every battle.

facilities.name: Pale Raven's Perch
facilities.does: Foresight and return to the Obelisk Chamber. No feeding.

facilities.name: Inn
facilities.does: Support conversations. New ones open if Support was high enough in Part I.

facilities.name: Dispatch Officer
facilities.does: One Army Action per chapter, then start the battle.

lord_facilities.does: Temple Administrator also boosts Combat Arts and teaches Secrets

prep.facilities_until: Ch 4 is the last chapter with facilities. Ch 5 has none; Ch 6 has only the Pale Raven's Perch.

army_actions.name: Training Drills
army_actions.does: Raises weaker units' levels toward your stronger ones.

army_actions.name: Group Drills
army_actions.does: Skill EXP to every unit's two main weapon skills.

army_actions.name: Group Service
army_actions.does: Raises one god's Blessing level. Unavailable when all Blessings are maxed.

chapters.name: The Battle of Klytius Plains
chapters.prep: Training Drills recommended: brings the army to Lv 37-38 so every recruit can take an Advanced exam.

battles.name: Struggle in Klytius
enemies: 44 enemies at start, most Lv 35; 8 with an HP reserve
Three named enemies, all mounted (two in the center)
Creek on the field (enemy)
A Warrior on the west side
guests: Bertrand's Brezarant army, starting on the left/southwest lane
mechanics: Three-lane south side
Thickets give Avoid
tips: Split into three lanes; Bertrand's army holds the left
Anti-cavalry up the center
Merge left and center once the first wave falls
End turns on Thickets
Physic healers in range of the center

chapters.name: Showdown at Agris Stronghold
chapters.prep: Training Drills bring the army to about Lv 40. Bring a flier to catch the southeast Ranger, plus mages and anti-cavalry.

battles.name: Taking Agris Stronghold
enemies: Lind and Ianuarius in a corner
Strong cavalry and high-Def knights
Archers on Onagers (artillery)
Ranger, southeast: carries a drop, moves Turn 4 and flees north then off the east edge
Ranger, west: carries a drop, moves Turn 8 and flees
battles.reinforcements: From the west, southeast and east sides throughout.
mechanics: Select an enemy on an artillery tile to see its range
Forests give Avoid
Center cliff: fliers only
tips: 3-4 strong units up the east path; the rest northwest to the center
Pincer the bosses from two sides
Kill the Onager archers first, then use the center with fliers
Leave a few units back for flank reinforcements

recruits.how: Defeat him here. Joins only if "My Late Sister's Accessory" was done in Part I on this lord's route (Leda or Dietrich only). Usable from Ch 3.

chapters.name: Beyond the Salt Road
chapters.prep: Training Drills to about Lv 41. Several Physic users, tanks for chokepoints, fliers; spend the stacked Concoctions here. Kalla's Blessing Lv 3 helps.

battles.name: Grand Aragon Invaded
enemies: Gilchris (boss)
Nathan (enemy; recruitable)
Chariot archers
War elephants
battles.reinforcements: Frequent, from the west and east ends of the main east-west road; continuous after a point.
mechanics: Narrow alleys: hold chokepoints with armor, fire from range behind them
Elephants charge through blockades in 2-wide lanes
Crossing the north edge of the main east-west road makes Gilchris set fire tiles across the map (damage and slow)
tips: Push for Gilchris once the chokes hold; killing him ends the map
Fliers plus Blessings finish him before the fire spreads
guests: Aswan and Tahonia walk toward your lord. Talk to them to make them guests. Keep both alive: they join for good in Part III Fifth Section.

recruits.how: Creek must land the killing blow on Nathan. Joins next chapter. No Creek, no Nathan.

chapters.name: The Storming of Dagsion
chapters.prep: Training Drills to about Lv 42. Bring 3-4 bow users. Last chapter with facilities.

battles.name: The Battle of Alcineus Span
enemies: Lind, behind war elephants at the top
Fliers, elephant riders, Ornius riders
Dragoons from the map sides (limited)
battles.reinforcements: Heavy early: from the south section of the bridge behind you as you climb, plus Dragoons from the sides. They are limited.
mechanics: Elephant charges are predictable and destroy barricades
Bait a charge with a high-Move unit stepping into its vision and back out
tips: Advance slowly at first; clear the side Dragoons before pushing
Clear the units around a charging elephant first
Gang up on Lind

chapters.name: Divine Emperor Dagda
chapters.prep: No facilities. Explore Dagsion; you can only move toward Dagda's Temple at the top of Hightown. Bring magic users (Game8: Blizzard) or Salamanders, a dodger to bait artillery, and a Longbow for Deadeye.

battles.name: Battle vs. Dagda the Great
enemies: Dagda: phase 1 humanoid, phase 2 dragon at the top of the stairs; Res much lower than Def
Golems on protect tiles at the top (each carries a drop)
Fire Orb and Onager at the top of the stairs
battles.reinforcements: Spawn when you approach the stairs.
mechanics: The starting area is partly inside Onager range
Stairs hinder cavalry: dismount
Ballistae at the south end break golem shields from range
Fire blocks the side golem (charged AoE) but normal enemies cross it
Guard spots at the top give large Def bonuses
Dagda takes no damage at the top: hit him once (Deadeye from the map's Longbow) and Eshmel appears next turn to disable his Shield
tips: Move the army north to the Onager and block chokepoints for phase 1
Clear the stair base first; park a dodger at max artillery range to waste ammo
Lure Golems off protect tiles
Then gang up on Dagda
Players call Ch 5 the hardest Part II map (Reddit, community)

chapters.name: The Underworld Incarnate
chapters.prep: Walk to the marker. Only the Pale Raven's Perch. Two battles back to back. Use Blessings from Turn 1.

battles.name: Battle vs. Lyrah
enemies: Lyrah: shields make her invulnerable; phase 2 cocoon starts the same turn phase 1 ends
Reinforcements swarm after phase 1
mechanics: Break shields with weak long-range hits, ideally from the corners
The cocoon heals a little on every hit: only big hits
Large square tiles give different defense bonuses
The east side of the boss has more room than the west
tips: Let enemies come to you
Save the heavy hitters for the HP bars and for phase 2
Most reported game overs: pulling the center group early (Reddit, community)

battles.name: Flight from Dagsion
enemies: Enemies stand on the escape tiles
Center group: don't pull it
mechanics: Miasma deals 30 damage to a unit that starts its turn in it
tips: [Hero] and the strongest units go down the western edge to the exit
The split-off upper-right group turtles in its corner
Bring a Cleansing Blade or Seraphim user for the escape tiles
Aurora's Blessing (RPG Site) or Kalla's Blessing Lv 3 for Move (Game8)
battles.after: A short dungeon with no enemies: run to the marker. Then Part III opens.

missables.text: Equip what each unit should carry. Only equipped items enter Part II.
Southeast Ranger flees from Turn 4: kill him for his drop.
West Ranger moves from Turn 8 and flees: kill him for his drop.
Creek joins when defeated, only with "My Late Sister's Accessory" done on this route (Leda or Dietrich).
Creek must kill Nathan, or Nathan is lost for this War Path.
Talk to Aswan and Tahonia and keep both alive: they join in Part III Fifth Section.
Last chapter with facilities: spend Licenses, Supports and Army Action here.

open_questions: Deploy cap: Game8's hub says Part II asks for up to 15 units; its chapter boxes say 10 (Ch 1) and 13 (Ch 2 to 6). Rows use the boxes.
Vendetta: Game8's Ch 3 page and the FE Fandom wiki say Gilchris drops it; Game8's item page says "obtain after Part 2 Chapter 6". The catalog uses the Ch 3 drop.
Dagda's Club: Game8's Ch 5 page calls it Dagda's drop; other pages call it a Part II reward. Either way it comes from Ch 5.
Levin Sword +1: RPG Site says Creek drops it in Ch 1, while his recruit fight is Ch 2. Check whether Creek fights in both.
Theodora's War Path: no lord facility is listed for her (Battalions?).
Whether Skip runs Training Drills-level EXP or less: only 'less EXP and Skill EXP' is documented.

Deploy cap, Reddit: 13 controllable slots (15 with two auto guests), one report says 14 on Theodora's route; nobody confirms 10 in Ch 1. Check the prep screen (https://www.reddit.com/r/fireemblem/comments/1wwgbnw/fortunes_weave_part_2_four_times/).
